primary_book_check.finding: 出版社原作者访谈描述太阳变暗、恒星能量被生物吸收的共同危机，以及与外星智慧生命合作。原卷以alien attack概括使命未被该一手梗概支持，不能把原摘要当准确事实gold；不据访谈否定小说有外星生命。

risks: A两本书相似点原22C为人物生活挣扎，不能只因信/便条便自动同归完整书信体。
Bsuperficial原26A narrow为所给项近似，非精确同义词穷尽。
C真实品牌电动船性能/充电/维护/相对环保与价格为原推广断言，未做实物或厂商验证。
D从小鼠反应/观察期推到真正抹除记忆及长期疗效，范围/伦理/作者立场需保持限制；不当心理或医疗事实。
C东西文化二分、东部语言大多象形以及族群造成差异等概括缺证且过宽，不作文化语言事实准绳。
D33实际为比较三种组别，候选D写列举三次实验，原键D未精确对应方法，不升级gold。
A23月频相同为原键，多个宽泛自然探索表述可能有重合；源key非独立裁决。
A22 babies fit the specifically targeted 0-5 program, but all-age Family Friendly Days may also admit them. Do not treat suitable as exclusive eligibility.
A intro requests advance booking while one program is called drop-in: registration/walk-in logistics are not fully reconciled.
C history, pictographic/Latin classification and race/near-isolation causal simplifications not facts gold.
D33 three groups does not imply three experiments; grouping/allocation/control and actual underlying study not independently established.
A课程学分及拼接词的版面/数目不清，原197正则词数低估不能当自然分词负荷；原毕业/学业测试政策日期未获辖区一手核验。
B物种数量等现实时间敏感断言未独立核验；C/D已全文体裁核读但尚缺独立事实核验，不以输入状态true证明事实真。
C心理想象与D海星再生条件/物种范围仅按原报告留存，未获得一手实验或物种适用条件，不转写为普遍事实。
A fused tokens Icredit/1credit and civic sandcitizenship, omitted bullets and questionable literacy-rule date prevent treating raw word count or this notice as jurisdiction policy gold.
B species/population estimates and time-sensitive ranger statistics unverified.
C29 offers physical functions and emotional responses while the text explicitly mentions both: C/D are plausible overlapping answers. Do not imitate this as a uniquely keyed item.
C same neural circuits/physiological equivalence and performance claims overstate what these excerpts alone establish.

D whole-animal regeneration from any tiny limb, perfect restoration and human translation require species/central-disc, method, conditions and clinical evidence; not established by a confident expository tone.
A完整3x2费用格为Q54必要输入，不能只留金额叙述或丢表；15题实际是3篇各5，并非同为15题的4篇3+4+4+4。
原借阅服务规则只是该文规则，不当任何真实图书馆当前服务承诺；原键非gold。
B57 asks capitalize on in paragraph2 but phrase occurs in the third paragraph in the cached body. Preserve source locator conflict; authored question must use actual paragraph position.
B worries/support context is not evidence that packed lunch prevents disorders or cures loneliness.
C opening says same response while later reports species differences; some dog cognition/appearance/neurochemical generalizations lack primary conditions.
C64 emotional-signal influence (C) is a broad possible mechanism and nurturing response (D) the more precise metaphor target; avoid overlapping broad/narrow distractors in new keys.
D54 B/D提供数据与分享数据近义，目的题存在可辩护竞争项；原键不作充分排他裁决。
幸福调查的年龄群/评分量表与相关因果需分开，现实调查统计未独立核验；不复制健康因果结论。
已核A是结交朋友步骤建议而非服务通知，B是致孙辈的私人信叙事；只靠原行计数不够判体裁，初始占位标签不作命题准绳。
A40 introduction and discussing surroundings both occur in the contact sequence; source wording may favour the final break-ice instruction without making the first action generally wrong.
C source has 50 sampled birds,56 caught,41 tracked and151 complete flights; do not silently equate units or assume every captured bird was tracked.
C48 future habitat model cannot make outcomes certain; the strongest fitting option concerns projecting tundra location.
D age labels for World Happiness Report, teen cohort claims and attributions/real statistics not independently verified.
D54 provide data(B)/share data(D) near-synonymous; original key not unique-best gold.
D smartphone association does not establish cause; scale10 and scale3 trends remain different datasets.
A21advertisement and invitation overlap in everyday terms; A23required-skills versus preferred-similar-work comparison needs explicit other-conditions scope.
Bpanic escape/proverb is narrative not verified emergency advice; C/Disclaimed effects and named studies not independent fact gold.
D31thingofthepast is introductory rhetoric; source also defends current handwriting role. D33mindseye target spans source line break, not shortened mind.

Q26publishedAasksfriendstobuybooks versus literalDstrangersdonation both supported routes; printed explanation selects earlier sentence but ignores direct later evidence. Exclude unique-best exemplar, retain originalkeyA unchanged.
Dselfreported every24hours versus basedona24hourrecall may describe different collection frequency; do not infer daily reporting protocol from a retrospective recall window.
D33optionBnutrition-key is expert commentary, not an experimental causal conclusion. D34attitude to breakfast is different from caution about study limitations; no near-synonym gold upgrade.
AUN2021attribution appears in later editorial explanation; cover2024source and currently applicable programme rules are separate and unauthenticated.

Native text omits Bportrait and Cguineafowl pictures/captions; now original pages4/5 visually bound. Photos are not response-coded diagrams, but lexical/support input must be explicitly handled in authored successors, not claimed identical visual load.

Q26A wording specifically asks friends to buy books, whereas text says friends donate books or money to buy books; these are not identical propositions. Dreceivingdonatedbooksfromstrangers is explicitly supported. This is a printed-key/unique-best risk, not an automatic A/D two-key acceptance rule; do not silently repair original keyA or count it as validated gold.
